title: Death of Mumtaz Mahal inspires the Taj Mahal
summary: Mumtaz Mahal, the beloved wife of the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan, died in Burhanpur giving birth to her fourteenth child.
reason: She had accompanied her husband on a military campaign in the Deccan, and the birth went badly.
significance: Grieving, Shah Jahan built the Taj Mahal in Agra as her tomb.
